card.name: Words that set up excess or fault
card.fires_on: Words in general web text that judge something as foolish, costly, failed or wrongly done, just before an adverb or noun of excess or needlessness could follow. Examples are 'foolish it', 'more expensive', 'failed ideology', 'too heavily'.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning unnecessarily, indiscriminately, excessively and redundant, including Chinese equivalents.
card.plain: It fires on words that criticize something as wasteful, foolish or overdone, and nudges the next word toward 'unnecessarily' or 'excessively'.
